mainEntity.name: What is a granny suite and what does it typically include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A granny suite, often called an in-law suite or mother-in-law apartment, is a self-contained living space created on a residential property for aging parents, extended family, or guests. It generally features a private bedroom, a full bathroom, and dedicated living space, and it may include an independent entrance or kitchenette depending on property layout and household needs. As an addition to your home or a converted existing area, the suite balances personal independence with proximity to family care. Designing one usually involves assessing accessibility upgrades, such as step-free entries or walk-in showers, to comfortably support long-term living.
acceptedAnswer.description: A granny suite is a dedicated, self-contained living area on a residential property featuring a bedroom, bathroom, and living space tailored for aging family members or guests.
